crossRefs.keyword: that is perfect shall be as his master. or, shall beperfected as his master

translations.web: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
translations.bsb: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
translations.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
translations.asv: The disciple is not above his teacher: but every one when he is perfected shall be as his teacher.
